$comment: The owner's indoor-party opponent, eleventh round: a male dancer with lots of bling, facing away until Macron enters, chains swinging as he dances. Violet jacket over a guayabera is the approved default for this room's lead. The chains are drawn at rest here; their swing is planned as a beat-driven puppet layer, which the pipeline has not done yet.
description: Indoor party opponent, the BlinBlin dancer: a confident adult man dripping in gold, who starts with his back to the room.
traits: lean confident adult man of about forty-five, slow unimpressed half smile, layered gold chains
demeanor: cool, unhurried and unimpressed, until he is impressed

garments.text: cream guayabera shirt, open at the neck
polished two-tone cream and dark shoes

drawing.fits: hair, both shoes and both hands
drawing.look: tall, lean, angular adult build, narrow face with a trimmed goatee, easy sly half smile with kind, amused eyes, warm brown skin, short slicked-back black hair, several thick gold rope chains of different lengths hanging over his chest down to his belly with one large gold medallion, gold rings on his fingers, a chunky gold wristwatch, gold hoop earring, cream guayabera shirt open at the neck, long open midnight-violet jacket, slim dark trousers, polished two-tone cream and dark shoes and thick dark ink outline
drawing.extra: Both eyes are open. He is a grown man of about forty-five. The gold chains are big, bright and easy to see, lying on top of the shirt.

front.description: standing square and upright facing the viewer, feet a little apart, both arms relaxed and held a little away from the body, both open hands visible

back.description: seen from directly behind, his back to the viewer, standing upright with feet a little apart, both arms relaxed, the plain back of his long jacket and the back of his head, a thin gold chain at the nape of his neck
back.look: tall, lean, angular adult build, warm brown skin, short slicked-back black hair, thin gold chain at the nape of his neck, gold rings on his fingers, a chunky gold wristwatch, long midnight-violet jacket with a plain back and a centre vent, slim dark trousers, polished two-tone cream and dark shoes and thick dark ink outline
